prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Forest Arena body-proportion unification reference, one character's idle animation, 16 distinct right-facing full-body poses.
Input images: Image 1 is the TARGET CHARACTER's identity reference ONLY (face, hair, clothing, colors, species-specific ears/tail/items). Image 2 is JA-HYUN's approved idle 4x4 pose sheet, the PRIMARY BODY-PROPORTION reference. Image 3 is an enlarged exact in-game JA-HYUN idle frame, the final silhouette/proportion reference. Do not add Ja-Hyun's mouse identity or clothing to the target.

Primary request: Redraw the target character with exactly the same head-to-body and limb proportions as Ja-Hyun. This is a genuine anatomical redraw, not resizing the old target drawing. Match head size relative to torso, shoulder width, upper/lower arm lengths, thigh/shin lengths, hand size, and shoe scale to the Ja-Hyun reference. About three heads tall excluding ears, with a distinct torso and substantial visible bent legs. Preserve adult feminine identity without changing the body construction into a smaller baby-like two-head figure or a tall realistic figure.

Style/medium: clean polished non-pixel semi-dimensional chibi game sprite art, crisp outlines and controlled shading. Same visual construction as Ja-Hyun. Preserve the target's approved original design features.

Composition/framing: exactly 16 different complete poses, 4 columns by 4 rows, read left-to-right top-to-bottom. All poses face screen-right in a consistent three-quarter game view and share the same anatomical size, camera and grounded foot baseline within each row. Generous transparent gutters and at least 5% padding at every edge; absolutely no touching between figures and no cropping of ears, hair, shoes, ribbons or tail. Keep a low balanced grounded fighting stance with similar knee bend to Ja-Hyun, both feet planted. Arrange decorative ears/tail behind and beside the body rather than shrinking the body to fit.

Motion: a coherent 16-pose cyclic idle: settle into guard; small breathing rise; slight weight transfer forward; relaxed guard adjustment; small breathing fall; weight transfer back; return smoothly to starting guard. Both feet stay planted, no attack or run or big jump. Show genuine small changes in arms, torso, knees, hair, ears and tail/ribbons, not repeated identical images.

Scene/backdrop: truly transparent RGBA, no colored/white/black background, no checkerboard pixels, no floor and no cast shadow.
Avoid: mouse ears or mouse tail on the target, blended characters, extra limbs or ears or tails, fur-covered human limbs, paws, animal muzzle, digitigrade legs, brands, text, labels, numbers, watermark, panel borders, opponent, scenery, hitboxes or VFX.
